comparison.objective: Wind, hand-transfer, and pin a torsion spring versus commission an adjustable shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual spring winding under stored torque, regrasping, and pin insertion versus tool insertion, collar rotation, locking, and dynamic-response diagnosis.
comparison.success_condition: Spring must complete three-quarter turns and be pinned; candidate requires two compliant physical stopping cycles and retained adjustment.
comparison.reason: Both involve rotation and force control, but the core tested mechanics—stored-torque winding and pinning versus iterative damping calibration—are meaningfully different. Detailed spring thresholds are unavailable.
